title: Museum of Texas Handmade Furniture

services.name: Facility rentals
services.desc: Located in downtown New Braunfels in the Heart of the Texas Hill Country the Museum of Texas Handmade Furniture is an ideal venue for your wedding ceremony/reception, gala, holiday celebration, party, or corporate event. Your guests will love the striking beauty of our 10 acre property, the picturesque collection of early Texas buildings, and spacious, recently renovated Solms School that make your small events elegant and memorable. Rentals support the Museum of Texas Handmade Furniture exhibitions and educational programming. Solms School, once part of the Historic Four Mile Creek School complex was built in 1907.
